title: SCP-3998, The Wicker Witch Lives
description: A skeleton witch bound to a wooden cross, burning at night and punishing murderers with fire.
body:
The Wicker Witch Lives adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-3998, also known as The Wicker Witch Lives .


SCP-3998 appears as a human cadaver without any legs. At day it remains inactive and only creating a dripping yellow liquid, but at night it ignites, becoming a fiery omen that punishes those who attempted murder. Any player who has killed villagers or other players will be set on fire. However, water stops it from igniting.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-3998 spawn?

SCP-3998 can spawn anywhere on the overworld surface like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-3998.

► How can I reset a players kills?

You can decrease the counts of murder from players by using the command /reset_wickerwitch_kills

</details>



![SCP-3998](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f8beafd13e9b14b1d59d8aa2860fa68ec69ad7d.png)

SCP-3998 is a human skeleton without legs, fixed to a wooden cross. It does not move, but occasionally emits yellow dripping particles. At night SCP-3998 bursts into flames if not submerged in water or rain. It is fully fire-immune, and while burning, it ignites any player within 60 blocks who has recently killed three or more villagers or other players.
